description: R-SQL-1 SQL-B: How are an ambiguous unqualified field (id in L and LD), an unknown field, an unknown qualified field and an unknown qualifier classified, and at which call does each outcome appear? Each is opened directly; the ambiguous and the unknown field are also put in temporary QueryDefs whose Parameters are enumerated, opened without a value, and (unknown field) opened again after Parameters("nosuch") = 2. Runs on a fresh copy of r-sql-1-accdb-main opened read-only through ACE DAO; each statement is opened with Database.OpenRecordset as a snapshot unless stated, Fields Name/Type/Size/SourceTable/SourceField are read before the first row, then every row's Field values to EOF (each MoveNext captured), then Close and DBEngine.Errors.
retentionNote: Designed r-sql-1 probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
